senses.definition: a Manassite, 1 Ch 27:21, 𝔊 Ιαδδαι.
one of those who took foreign wives Ezr 10:43 Kt (Qr יַדַּי; cf. Palm. ידי = dilectus Vog No. 5), 𝔊 Δια, A Ιαδει, 𝔊L Ιαδιαι.
